column1: # What each mission control event kind is to the operator, read by
# scripts/mc-lib.sh's mc_event_wakes. The wake relay and the failsafe tick
# (scripts/mc-wake.sh) never raise a turn for a `routine` kind: the script
# that emitted it already acted, and the event stays listable in the store.
# Every other class wakes mission control. decision, blocker, failure and
# landed are the classes an operator-facing report carries
# (scripts/mc-inbox.sh report); `act` wakes mission control to act on the
# operator's behalf and reaches the operator only as one of those four, when
# the act turns into one. A kind with no row wakes, as `act` does, so a new
# kind is never silenced by omission.
